topics.text: Reset a forgotten account password using the recovery link sent to your registered email address.
topics.negative: Change a known account password from the signed-in security settings.
topics.en: I cannot remember my login secret; how do I regain access?
topics.ja: パスワードを忘れてログインできません。どうすれば復旧できますか。

topics.text: A customer receives a refund to the original payment card after returning a defective purchase.
topics.negative: A customer receives store credit after exchanging an unwanted gift without a receipt.
topics.en: Where does my money go when I send back a broken item?
topics.ja: 壊れた商品を返品したとき、返金はどこに入りますか。
topics.alias: How is a card reimbursement paid?

topics.text: Rechargeable batteries store electricity from solar panels for use at night.
topics.negative: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity during the day without storing it.
topics.en: How can a home use sunshine-generated power after sunset?
topics.ja: 日没後に太陽光で作った電気を使うには何が必要ですか。
topics.alias: What does a home BESS do?

topics.text: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) adds a one-time code from an authenticator app after the password.
topics.negative: Single sign-on (SSO) shares one identity login across several business applications.
topics.en: Which login protection asks for an extra temporary number?
topics.ja: パスワードの後に一時的なコードを入力する認証方法は何ですか。

topics.text: An offline backup preserves a disconnected copy of files so ransomware cannot encrypt the copy.
topics.negative: Cloud file synchronization copies deletions and encrypted changes immediately to every connected device.
topics.en: How do I keep a safe file copy beyond a ransomware attack's reach?
topics.ja: ランサムウェアに暗号化されないようにファイルのコピーを保管する方法は何ですか。

topics.text: TLS (Transport Layer Security) encrypts information while it travels between a browser and a server.
topics.negative: Disk encryption protects information saved on a powered-off laptop's storage drive.
topics.en: What protects private data as it crosses the network to a website?
topics.ja: ブラウザーからサーバーへ送信中のデータを暗号化する技術は何ですか。

topics.text: 配達予定日を過ぎても荷物が届かない場合、追跡番号を用意して配送会社に問い合わせます。
topics.negative: 受け取り済みの荷物の中身が破損している場合、写真を撮影して販売店に返品を申し込みます。
topics.en: My parcel is late and has not arrived. Who should I contact?
topics.ja: 予定日を過ぎても商品が届きません。どこに連絡すればよいですか。
topics.alias: How do I investigate a missing shipment?

topics.text: 図書館の本を延長するには、返却期限前にオンラインの貸出記録から更新を選択します。
topics.negative: 図書館の本を予約するには、貸出中の本の検索画面で予約ボタンを押します。
topics.en: How can I keep a borrowed library book for longer before it is due?
topics.ja: 借りた本の返却期限を延ばしたいです。手続きは何ですか。
topics.alias: How does a library loan renewal work?

topics.text: A peanut allergy warning identifies food containing peanuts or possible peanut traces from shared equipment.
topics.negative: A gluten-free label identifies food made without wheat, barley or rye proteins.
topics.en: Which warning helps someone avoid nuts hidden in food or production residue?
topics.ja: ピーナッツが混入する可能性を知らせる食品表示はどれですか。
topics.alias: What does a peanut cross-contact warning mean?

topics.text: During a building fire, use the stairs and leave through the nearest safe emergency exit.
topics.negative: During a fire drill, staff count people at the outdoor assembly point after they leave the building.
topics.en: There is a fire inside; which route should I take to get out?
topics.ja: 建物で火災が起きた場合、安全に逃げるために何を使いますか。
topics.alias: What is the fire egress route?

topics.text: Drip irrigation slowly delivers water directly to plant roots through small tubes.
topics.negative: Overhead sprinklers spray water across leaves and surrounding paths through rotating nozzles.
topics.en: Which watering method feeds roots gradually without spraying the whole garden?
topics.ja: 植物の根元へ少しずつ水を送る灌漑方法は何ですか。

topics.text: 電車の定期券を紛失した場合、駅の窓口で本人確認書類を提示して再発行を申請します。
topics.negative: 電車の乗車券を購入する場合、券売機で行き先と人数を選び料金を支払います。
topics.en: I lost my railway season pass. Where can I request a replacement?
topics.ja: 通勤定期券をなくしました。再発行の申請先はどこですか。
topics.alias: How do I replace a lost commuter pass?

A courier transports documents across the city.
